title: Ines and the Ghost
author: Jude Reyes
blurb: Juniper Voss, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
